objective: Prove #P-hardness for every failure of (P2) or (P3) at an occurring sector order that the gadget calculus reaches (class at most 4, graded), recover the total homomorphism count across sectors, and state precisely what remains (a counterexample, or a substantive obstruction such as local base terms).

title: Hardness for pair and triple failures at every sector order
